# Fast.com
> Fast.com is Netflix’s free web-based internet speed test for measuring download speed, upload speed, latency, and related connection quality metrics.

Fast.com offers a minimal interface for quickly estimating internet performance from the browser. The site is primarily centered on the speed test itself, with localized versions for many languages and a small set of supporting informational pages.

## Core Experience
- [Internet Speed Test](https://fast.com): Main speed test homepage that automatically measures internet download speed in the browser.
- [English (US)](https://fast.com/en): English-language version of the Fast.com speed test interface.
- [English (UK)](https://fast.com/en/gb): British English localized version of the speed test.
- [Settings and advanced metrics](https://fast.com/#): Speed test interface with options for showing upload, latency, and additional details.

## Help and Information
- [About Fast.com](https://fast.com/about): Explains what Fast.com measures and how the service works.
- [Privacy](https://fast.com/privacy): Describes privacy practices and handling of data collected by Fast.com.
- [Terms of Use](https://fast.com/terms): Legal terms governing use of the Fast.com website and service.
- [Netflix](https://www.netflix.com): Parent company website for Netflix, which operates Fast.com.

## What Fast.com Measures
- [Download speed test](https://fast.com): Measures estimated download throughput from Fast.com servers to the browser.
- [Upload speed test](https://fast.com): Optional advanced measurement for upload throughput.
- [Latency and unloaded ping](https://fast.com): Reports responsiveness metrics relevant to browsing and real-time applications.
- [Loaded latency](https://fast.com): Shows latency under load to help assess connection quality during active transfers.
- [Connection details](https://fast.com): Displays client, server, and measurement details in the expanded results view.
